Overview

Avignon is a city in Provence-Alpes-Côte d’Azur with a population of 92,000. The City of Popes with a magnificent medieval Papal Palace, a famous theater festival, and the iconic Pont d’Avignon. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
